scope: Existing React/Vite presentation framework with an action workbench, actual EVY dispatch, Rust execution, bounded simulation connectivity/interruption/recovery controls and a self-contained private hardware handoff repository.

gates.TDD: Retain red-first service and frontend behavior tests, then passing suites.
gates.CDD: Strict action/control bindings, operator/viewer roles, same-origin protection, fixed configured endpoints and simulation-only lab authority.
gates.BDD: Transfer to real simulator, actual data-plane disconnection with later control/completion, reconnect, executor interruption, explicit recovery and deliberate new action.
gates.CBT: Browser to frontend bridge to actual EVY HTTPS gateway and distinct Rust/simulator process; observers never imply the central link remains connected.
gates.EDD: Retained baseline is labeled historical; current-session metrics only from current responses; unknown/unreachable stays unknown; exported evidence and code identities.
gates.HANDOFF: Fresh private repo builds without sibling repositories, temporary-path dependencies or lab credentials; explicit Preston hardware acceptance gates.

limits: No physical-motion authorization or hardware adapter inference.
A local separate-process session does not inherit the historical Flightpath separate-host qualification.
Controls are disabled on profiles lacking explicit simulation-lab capability.
Recovery does not silently start another action.
decision: Use existing EVY action contract and Rust executor. New HTTP control endpoints are explicitly scoped to a disposable simulator lab.
